entities.name: Kōchi Chōjō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kōchi ueekata Chōjō  was a Ryukyuan aristocrat known for leading a movement to petition the government of Qing Dynasty China to rescue the Ryūkyū Kingdom from annexation by Imperial Japan, following the 1872 announcement by the government of Meiji Japan to do so.
